subtasks: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
Uncover the red block first by lifting the middle yellow cup and setting it aside behind the center block. Leave the left and right cups in place.

Uncover the green block next: use the left hand to lift the leftmost yellow cup off the green block and set it aside on the open table in front of that block. Keep the red block exposed and leave the rightmost cup in place.

Uncover the blue block last. Use the right gripper to lift the rightmost yellow cup off the blue block and set it on the open tabletop in front of that block. Leave red and green uncovered, withdraw both hands, and return both arms to their starting poses.
